title: A block copolymer ascg builds, from a description: system and AA plan for review
prompt: I want a coarse-grained model of a polystyrene-block-poly(methyl acrylate) melt: chains of 5 styrene units followed by 5 methyl acrylate units, atactic, two beads per styrene (backbone and phenyl) and two per methyl acrylate (backbone and ester), fitted at 450 K and 500 K. ascg should build the all-atom system itself. Prepare the system description and the all-atom plan in a study called blocks for me to review. Do not approve anything on my behalf and do not run any simulation.

checks.expr: r['check']['size']['chains'] == 50 and r['check']['size']['cg_beads'] == 1000 and r['check']['size']['repeat_units'] == 10 and len(r['check']['units']) == 2 and r['mapping'] == 'proposed'
